s1.title: Help is closer than you think
s1.intro: Benefits, health care, records and support for veterans and their families — and people nearby who can help you find your way through it, free of charge.

box_1.heading: Veterans Crisis Line — free, confidential, 24/7
box_1.text: You don't have to be enrolled in VA benefits or health care to call. Family and friends can call too.

box_1.heading: San Luis Obispo County Veterans Services
box_1.text: Accredited officers help veterans and families apply for VA and state benefits at no cost. By appointment.
box_1.text_2:
801 Grand Avenue, San Luis Obispo
(805) 781-5766

box_2.heading: San Luis Obispo Vet Center
box_2.text: Confidential counseling for veterans, service members and their families, from the VA.

box_3.heading: Post 432 Service Officer
box_3.text: Not sure where to start? Our Service Officer can point you and your family toward the benefits and help you've earned.
